name: clear
purpose: Clears the visible terminal screen and moves the prompt back to the top.
explanation: Clears terminal scrollback/viewport clutter without affecting your current directory, running background jobs, or shell history.
expectedOutput: (Clears the visible terminal window and leaves a clean `$` prompt at the top)
whenToUse: When terminal output has filled the screen and you want a clean workspace.
commonMistakes: Assuming `clear` deletes files or erases command history (press Up arrow—history is still intact).
platformCompatibility: macOS (zsh/bash), GNU/Linux, Git Bash (Windows uses `cls` in CMD)
explanationOfOutput: Sends terminal control sequences to clear the visible viewport.
